limitations: Single 15-minute observation window; numbers are a snapshot.
Single vantage point (one public RPC node) for node-level figures; VHS API used for network-wide figures.
No WebSocket ledger stream: public WS requires authorization (401). Cadence derived from polling.
No consecutive ledger headers (8001203 and 8001214, 11 apart): parent-hash chain not fully verified; time ordering + per-index hash uniqueness checked instead.
No authenticated surface used: session/bearer Task Node routes documented from the public route registry only.
L1v2 (Consensus v2 + Cobalt) is specified design, not live on the testnet measured here.
VHS /v1/network/networks lists two webhook.site entries that look like test artifacts; reported as returned.

redactions.reason: Task Node public-directory probe outputs embedded per-user records (internal account IDs, wallet addresses, handles, display names). Validator-topology addresses (VHS) and the public genesis account are public ledger infrastructure and were NOT redacted.
redactions.preserved: record counts, totals, scores, task titles, statuses, timestamps and all aggregate figures are unchanged; structure is unchanged
